name: Nullframe GhostTouch Infiltration Glove
description:
Skintight wrist-length gloves in charcoal-grey synthetic dermis, nearly indistinguishable from bare skin at distance. The outer surface is micro-textured with passive print-disruption coating — contact leaves no usable fingerprint, only smeared static. Inner palm channels are seeded with gecko-fiber adhesion strips that activate under pressure, releasing cleanly on flex.

Cutaway options exist for augmented index and middle fingers — pre-slit seams that can be popped open without degrading the glove's integrity. Street label, no branding visible. Bought in matched pairs sealed in unmarked pouches.
functionality: Print-masking on all contact surfaces. Gecko-grip activates at 40%+ palm compression — effective on glass, polymer panels, and wet metal. Aug-compatible cutaway finger seams for chrome digits. Thin enough for full haptic sensitivity on touchpads and BCI panels.
what_it_says: You move through places you were not invited, and you leave nothing behind.
story_hooks: A pair surfaces at a Tier 5 Spire burglary scene — the gecko-fiber signature matches a batch sold exclusively through a Circuit black market broker who claims they were stolen from their own stock.
The print-disruption coating has begun failing on a specific production run, and whoever sold them knows — but hasn't issued a recall.
A Tier 3 accountant is found wearing a pair during a routine office audit; they have no explanation for how they got them.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4

physical_description.visual_profile: Nearly invisible at distance—a second skin in charcoal grey that blurs the boundary between glove and flesh. Worn loose or fitted to the wrist, they read as absence rather than garment. When examined close, the micro-texture catches light in a faint, static-like shimmer.
physical_description.fit: Skintight, second-skin compression that conforms to hand and wrist anatomy without restriction. Seamless at the fingertips, with deliberate pre-cut seams along index and middle fingers for optional augmentation access.
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic dermis—a biotech-adjacent polymer that mimics skin elasticity and thermal conductivity, treated with passive print-disruption coating
physical_description.texture: Micro-textured surface feels almost organic, faintly granular to touch. Inner palm contains gecko-fiber adhesion strips—barely perceptible raised channels that activate under pressure and release cleanly on flex
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey, desaturated to minimize visual contrast with human skin tones. No patterns; uniformly matte with reflective micro-static shimmer under direct light
physical_description.closures: None—friction-fit at the wrist, no seams or fasteners visible. Designed for immediate on/off without drawing attention
distinctive_features: Passive fingerprint-disruption coating—contact leaves only smeared static, no usable forensic data
Pre-slit seam channels running across index and middle fingers for quick augmentation access
Gecko-fiber palm adhesion strips for grip without abrasion or residue
Unmarked street manufacturing—zero branding, zero serial tracking
Sold in matched pairs in sealed, unmarked pouches
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 functional / black-market specialty. Expensive enough to signal intentional acquisition, cheap enough to remain deniable. Street-label manufacturing keeps it off corpo inventory.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by infiltrators, data couriers, security-adjacent operatives, and anyone operating in the legal grey. Signals preparedness, operational awareness, and willingness to move without leaving traces. Associated with Brineworks street ethos—practical, untraceable, built for people who need to vanish.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or broken-in depending on use; gecko-fiber strips lose adhesion with repeated flex cycles. Wear is mostly invisible—slight dulling of the micro-texture, possible micro-tears at the fingertip seams if augmentation access has been exercised multiple times. Treated with gentle care to preserve the fingerprint-disruption coating.
